description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of tests involving Git commands such as fast-export, fast-import, submodule handling, and marks files. The tests are designed to verify behaviors related to Git history dumping, large marks files, submodules, path adjustments, and relative marks management.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a test commit with a specified message.

methods.name: git fast-export
methods.description: Exports Git history to a desired format or file.

methods.name: git rev-parse
methods.description: Resolves Git revisions or objects to their SHA1 hashes.

methods.name: test_seq
methods.description: Generates a sequence of numbers for testing purposes.

methods.name: git fast-import
methods.description: Imports Git history from a dump or stream.

methods.name: git submodule add
methods.description: Adds a new submodule to the repository.

methods.name: git -C
methods.description: Runs Git commands in a specified directory.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a path does not exist.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files.
